manifestPatch.title: 2026 VSiN NFL Betting Guide 2.0
manifestPatch.use: Separate Meat Desk Source 3 for the VSiN NFL post-preseason update. Cross-reference Source 2 rather than replacing it; Betting Edge remains the betting-decision layer.
manifestPatch.notes: Four-pass 2.0 review complete. Source 2 remains visible as the original preseason board, including win totals, futures, props, awards and early Week 1 positions. Source 3 shows the post-preseason changes and current VSiN update context. Guide prices are historical until revalidated. VSiN 2.0 may inform Meat Desk and governed Graham/Walters revalidation but cannot directly create a BET or silently move BW FAIR.

publicFindings.label: SOURCE 3 // 2026 NFL POST-PRESEASON 2.0 // UPDATES SOURCE 2
publicFindings.state: ANALYZED // POST-PRESEASON UPDATE // CROSS-REFERENCED TO SOURCE 2 // LIVE REVALIDATION REQUIRED
publicFindings.disclaimer: VSiN 2.0 IS A POST-PRESEASON UPDATE LINKED TO THE PRESERVED SOURCE 2 PRESEASON BOARD. IT DOES NOT REPLACE SOURCE 2. SOURCE ODDS ARE HISTORICAL UNTIL REVERIFIED. SOURCE OPINION AND SYSTEMS DO NOT CREATE A BET.

carries.next: Treat as an author-level reversal only; verify the current futures price before any Betting Edge use.

systems.title: Makinen 32-team power ratings
systems.rule: All 32 raw Makinen power ratings in 2.0 are unchanged from the original guide.
systems.body: Treat the numeric ratings as CONFIRMED IN 2.0. Do not infer that older projected wins, schedule strength or every qualitative team thesis was also confirmed.
systems.state: Reference comparison only; do not mechanically average into Graham/Walters FAIR.

systems.title: Makinen Week 1 systems
systems.rule: Preserve system ID, rule, sample, market type and qualifying side; revalidate any line-dependent threshold against the current market.
systems.body: System clusters are correlated historical evidence, not independent votes. Conflicting systems remain visible rather than being netted away.
systems.state: ACTIVE only when the current line still qualifies; otherwise OUT OF RANGE.

systems.title: System 12 side vs total
systems.rule: Keep the rebound ATS observation and the historical Under result as separate markets.
systems.body: Do not collapse side and total evidence into one team-level signal.

systems.title: Graham/Walters boundary
systems.rule: VSiN 2.0 may supply current personnel/revalidation evidence but cannot silently move a carried Graham rating or BW FAIR.
systems.body: The unchanged Makinen ratings confirm the immutable VSiN origin seed. Any Graham rating change still requires an explicit governed delta and evidence.
